prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a luxury high-fashion magazine cover in a soft light purple lavender gradient background. Center an adult white female fashion model with delicate facial features, glowing natural skin and a confident elegant expression. She wears a dramatic high-volume couture gown made of layered tulle in pastel purple shades, creating a dreamy cloud-like silhouette, and holds a bouquet of lush purple flowers including roses, peonies and lilacs with a soft bokeh effect. Style her hair in a loose romantic updo with soft strands framing her face, subtle glamorous makeup, glossy lips and soft blush. Place the large bold magazine title BONANZA in a thick elegant serif font behind her head, partially obscured. Add refined cover text: The New Romance; Beauty in Bloom; Dress to Dream; 10 Ways to Elevate Your Style; Special Feature: The Art of Slow Fashion. Include a barcode, May issue date and the bottom tagline Live Beautifully – Fashion that inspires, empowers & transforms. Use soft diffused studio lighting, high-end editorial styling, ultra-realistic detail, cinematic color grading, shallow depth of field and luxury magazine typography. Preserve the supplied cover hierarchy, text and lavender couture concept.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, misspelled text, duplicated letters, illegible typography, cluttered layout
